What’s settled — and what isn’t

The route and itinerary are practical. The open decisions are dates, the six family names, and whether the group can move above the lodging target.

Decision needed first

The house budget is short by $1,225.

The least expensive verified one-house option that sleeps 24 was $3,225 total for three nights. Nothing within roughly 90 minutes of Colorado Springs met the $2,000 target.

Recommended drive

Irving → Amarillo → Raton → Colorado Springs

IrvingColorado
~765 mieach way
12–13 hwith breaks
$0planned tolls
Six-car convoy rule
Use a lead car and a tail car, set fuel stops before departure, and keep the car behind you in sight. Planned stops: Wichita Falls, Amarillo, and Raton.

Mileage math: about 1,530 highway miles round trip, plus roughly 250 miles for Colorado outings.

Four days, paced for families

The first evening stays easy for altitude adjustment; the two full days focus on Colorado Springs and the dunes.

Fri · Sep10

Drive north and settle in

Leave Irving at 6:00 AM. Break for lunch in Amarillo, reach the Colorado Springs area around 6–7 PM, buy groceries, hydrate, and keep the first night easy.

~12–13 hours with stops
Road day · Irving to Colorado Springs
Sat · Sep11

Pikes Peak + Garden of the Gods

Drive the Pikes Peak Highway in the morning, then spend the afternoon on the easy trails at Garden of the Gods. Finish with an evening walk in Manitou Springs.

~$52 per vehicle · confirm 2027 rates
Sun · Sep12

Great Sand Dunes day trip

Leave by 7:00 AM. Rent sand sleds near the park, bring sun protection and extra water, and return to the house for a group cookout.

$25 per vehicle · snapshot rate
Mon · Sep13

Pack out and head home

Check out around 10:00 AM. Make an optional short stop at Red Rock Canyon Open Space, then leave by 11:00 AM for Irving.

Expected home around 10–11 PM
Return day · same route south

The budget gap

$2,000 buys only 62% of the least expensive fit.

To keep one house, the group needs to approve at least $538 per family for lodging. Otherwise, the plan needs to switch to multiple smaller rentals or hotel rooms.

Sequence

    These dates are proposed, not final.
  2. Add all six family names
    Then confirm the 14-adult / 10-child count.
  3. Approve the lodging ceiling
    One-house reality starts around $3,225.

    The primary renter should be 25+ and stay on-site.
  5. Re-quote before paying
    Enter all 24 guests and confirm six-car parking in writing.

Watch-outs

AltitudeArrive hydrated, keep the first evening quiet, and watch children for headache, nausea, or unusual fatigue.
Mountain weatherCarry jackets for everyone and leave exposed summit areas before afternoon storms build.
Sleeping layout“Sleeps 24” does not mean 24 beds. Verify beds, cots, and room assignments.
Reservation timingConfirm 2027 Pikes Peak entry requirements and road status close to the trip.
